newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ushio shares tumble after earnings announcement.
newsitem.headline: Ushio shares tumble after earnings announcement.

text.p: Shares of Ushio Inc fell sharply on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on Monday afternoon after the company's latest earnings announcement, which included a forecast of lower group net profits in fiscal 1997/98.
At 0528 GMT, Ushio was down 150 yen, or 9.15 percent, at 1,490 yen. It was the largest percentage loser in the first section of the TSE.

The manufacturer of lamps and optical equipment earlier on Monday announced that its group net profit in 1996/97, which ended on March 31, rose 28.0 percent year-on-year to 7.65 billion yen, although it expected its group net profit for 1997/98 to fall 17.6 percent to 6.30 billion yen.
